information.description:
The poster child of Arasaka Security, the humble Soldier isn’t too far removed from what every other megacorp employs. They just get Arasaka-level gear for free, which is enough of an advantage in and of itself. ‘Saka soldiers are well-trained frontliners with milspec gear and weapons that tend to lead smaller squads of Guards or Rangers. If Soldiers themselves get deployed in numbers, then something really big is going down.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The Masamune is not just a rifle but a work of fine art. Designed in the 50's and manufactured from the best, most resilient materials, the Masamune is great for all conditions, while also being surprisingly light. Every single one of the Masamune's elements, down to the tiniest screws and bolts, were quality-ensured by a legion of Arasaka engineers – and you can feel it. Not only is it light to handle, but it's intuitive to use – even for first-time users. And to top it all off, it comes with state-of-the-art software and holographic sights and a three-round burst mode.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 24 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst when fired. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP (2 SP Normal / 3 SP Armor-Piercing). This weapon will not fire if there are less than 3 rounds in the magazine.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
Heavier version of an Armorjack for your head. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.
Metal plated armor to resist the most powerful hits. -4 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

During the Unification War, many “adaptive” combat armor designs were field tested. These trade all-around improvement for extreme specialization in reactivity, speed, or flexibility.

Body/Head Armor Enhancement. When installed, choose to reduce the penalty applied to a single STAT from the armor’s Armor Penalty (if any) by 2 (Minimum 0) (e.g., Reduce Flak Armor’s REF penalty by 2, but no reduction to DEX/MOVE penalties [-2 to REF, -4 to DEX and MOVE]). Cannot be Tech Upgraded to further reduce Armor Penalties.

Type: Armor Enhancement (Body/Head)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • The sheet uses one penalty for all three stats, so apply this by hand.
